name: polymarket
description: Polymarket prediction market — Rust API + Next.js frontend

/access/info.docs: Access gate info: owner-only mode + Terms of Use text/version/hash (public)

/access/challenge.docs: Owner sign-in challenge for ?address= — message embeds the terms hash, signing = accepting (public)

/access/verify.docs: Exchange {address, timestamp, signature} for a Bearer token; only the sudo/owner address is accepted; acceptance recorded to terms_accepted.json (public)

/access/check.docs: Probe whether the Bearer token is still valid

/sync/status.docs: Background sync schedule: cadence, last run, next run, last error

/sync/config.docs: Owner sets the sync cadence: {enabled?, intervalSecs|intervalMinutes|intervalHours} (5min–7d); persists to ~/.mod/polymarket/sync.json

/sync/run.docs: Run one background sync cycle now (bypasses the freshness skip)

/user-strats/{id}/share.docs: Bundle a strat + store it content-addressably (localfs default) -> CID

/user-strats/import.docs: Import a strat by CID as a private copy you own

/polymarket/api/hub.docs: Background backtest worker (served by the Next app, owner-gated): GET ?days=N returns the cached per-strat backtests + funnels and the worker's schedule; POST {days,strats} publishes the roster to keep warm (POST ?run=1 queues a pass); PUT runs a pass synchronously

mcp.docs: Read-only MCP server over the console: markets, leaderboard, one leader's flow (incl. its sub-hour candle share), the strats this deployment runs, the worker's cached backtests WITH the entry funnel, live sessions, and the live gate tally. No order-placing tool by design.
